messages:
Arun (PM): quick design question — account view for billing: should default be a single org summary row (compact heatline + top contributors) or full project rows? support keeps getting tickets about project sums not matching invoice and we need a clearer reconciliation path.
Maya (Design): I'm for compact by default. show org heatline + up to 3 contributor badges with tiny bars (muted). add an explicit "See invoice mapping" control in the header. expanding reveals full project rows.
Liam (Frontend): compact helps perf. rendering many SVG sparklines spikes CPU on older devices. plan: server-render org series and lazy-fetch project series on expand. badge overflow -> "+N". animate height on expand.
Sora (DataViz): aggregation = sum makes most sense for spend. show tokens as absolute plus delta, e.g., "8.6k (+2.1%)". heatline should plot net spend (post-credits) to match invoices. avoid stacked areas with many lines.
Ivy (Billing): invoice differences usually from credits, proration windows, and account-level allocations. modal "Invoice line-item mapping" should explain mapping rules, include sample calculation and CSV export. also link to billing policy doc.
Pri (Support): customers phrase it like "my project numbers don't add up to my invoice" — recommend short modal bullets and example math. add a one-liner in the rail: "Questions about totals?" linking to modal. we'll draft FAQ blurb.
Maya (Design): microcopy options for the token column: A) "Token units (billing)" B) "Billing tokens" C) "Tokens — invoice units" I prefer A because it's explicit without sounding technical.
Liam (Frontend): accessibility: sparklines need aria-labels with last/min/max. ensure badges and the "See invoice mapping" control are keyboard-focusable. color palette must meet 4.5:1 on text/foreground elements.
Sora (DataViz): UX extra: hover badge shows mini-reconciler popover: project spend vs invoice-linked amount + a "View mapping" CTA. cheap context without full expansion.
Ivy (Billing): backend work: expose /invoice_mapping?project_ids=.. endpoint that returns mapping and reason codes (credits/proration/allocation). generate as cached job (TTL 24h) because mapping agg can be expensive.
Arun (PM): decisions: 1) default: compact org heatline + up to 3 contributor badges; 2) "Expand projects" fetches per-project series; 3) add "Invoice line-item mapping" modal + badge reconciler popover; 4) token header: "Token units (billing)" with tooltip: "Billing units used on invoices; includes request and response tokens." 5) accessibility: aria labels + keyboard-focusable tooltips. 6) backend: invoice_mapping endpoint + 24h cache.
Pri (Support): I'll prepare the modal copy and short FAQ for release notes.
release-bot: staging deploy: staging/billing-compact-2024-12-02 queued :rocket:
Arun (PM): thanks all — I'll update the mocks and add acceptance criteria. sync next Tuesday for handoff.
